subject: Custom AnswerFun for type none questions

messages.author: 0cc91f41491ff09e
messages.subject: Custom AnswerFun for type none questions
parts:
Dear Phil,

I'm currently working on a next version of my CAT and have a vage debugging question.
In my new CAT, I want to display an item of type "none" first, i.e. just an item stimulus. By clicking "next" the participants are then send to the next items via a customnextitem function. In my app, I select the item of type "none" via the "start_item" parameter and mirtCAT also shows the item when starting. However, when clicking on the next button, the system crashes and I get the following error: 

Error in [[: subscript out of bounds
  [No stack trace available]

I've been fiddling around now for some time and found out the following:
- changing the itemtype of the question to "text" makes the CAT work (and select the later items correctly)
- The error is not related to the "customnextitem"-function, as the function is not being executed prior to the error (first thing in the function is "browser()", thus I would notice that the customnextitem-function was executed)
- Selecting the item later (i.e. as item 10) appears not to be a problem.

Overall, I think that the error may be related to the way the answer to the type none question is handled and how the result of this check is handled for the first question...

My questions would thus be:
- Any idea what the problem could be and how to solve it?
- How would a custom answer function to a type none question look like? (To make sure that the "answer" is handled correctly)

Thanks in advance and for your patience regarding these questions

Daniel

Hi Daniel,

This certainly looks like it could be a bug that should be patched. Would it be possible for you to send a simple reproducible example of this problem so that I can reproduce the issue? You're also more than welcome to open an issue on the mirtCAT github hosting location for easier tracking. Thanks.

Phil
